name: ETcath200
devices_driven: guidewire, RX balloon/stent catheter (guidewire arm); guiding catheter advance (catheter arm)
force_sensing: guidewire force sensing; claimed resolution 0.01 N (people.cn press)
haptics_leader: no (visual resistance display; joystick/roller control box)
imaging_compat: two passive arms on table rails, clear of X-ray equipment
validation_detail: RCT 73 robot vs 79 manual (yu2025_robot); 20 complex lesions (yang2026_feasibility)
key_numbers: RCT: clinical success 100% both, robot technical success 100%, longer procedure, lower operator dose (yu2025_robot abstract). Complex lesions: 16/20 (80%) technical success, 4 conversions, 61.0+-23.3 min (yang2026_feasibility).
